post.description: Bound to enrolled php_zip/API domain. 16 KiB body, endpoint context budget 2000 ms, 8 in-flight evaluations per process. GeoLite unavailable/expired or SQL failure returns 503 with no destination; unknown country from a valid database is explicit unknown. Optional risk feed failure stays unknown under published rule policy. Snapshot/compiler and signed GeoLite/feed readers are cached with bounded refresh; no network lookup per click. Central decisions are counted, browser execution is not acknowledged. Adapter default: connect 1s, total 3s, verify TLS, never follow API redirects, retry only same immutable request within remaining budget, otherwise 503 with no Location. No offline redirect bypass/fallback configured by B15.

post.summary: Authenticated API adapter probe; no click event and no CLI heartbeat
post.description: 16 KiB, context budget 2000 ms; domain/hostname bound. Central API/GeoLite and served revision confirmed, not public readiness. Returns raw ProbeState JSON and X-Shortlink-Proof HMAC response using existing purpose-separated ProbeMAC. PHP public handler first authenticates nonce request locally, then forwards nonce to this endpoint and returns response bytes/proof unchanged. Owner public HTTPS probe still pins public DNS/TLS, validates proof and rechecks revision/agent before readiness commit. Probe must not be exposed as a general unauthenticated credential-forwarding endpoint. ZIP handler implementation B16.

AdminSession.description: HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite session plus CSRF token on mutations.

AgentCredential.description: Per-agent credential bound to approved domains and API capabilities.

openingUrl.description: Root and missing slug redirect target. Empty means 503.

hostname.description: Normalized hostname only; reject URL, port, path, wildcard, local or reserved targets.

revision.description: Optimistic concurrency version of the link resource; increments on draft updates. Separate from the domain snapshot revision.

clicks.description: Published redirect events, not confirmed destination arrivals.

draftDestination.description: Optional pending destination. Published destination remains unchanged until publish; absent when no draft exists.

destination.description: HTTP(S) only, no embedded credentials or redirect loop.

revision.description: New resource revision. Each affected domain has its own desired config revision in domainRevisions.

destinationSource.description: link resolves the selected shortlink published destination; custom requires destination and is edited independently.

mandatory.description: Only permitted for global block rules; matching enabled mandatory blocks precede routing regardless of scope priority.

os.description: AND condition; * permits any value including unknown.

browser.description: AND condition; * permits any value including unknown.

asn.description: Optional ASN condition; unavailable ASN never matches.

botCategory.description: Optional AND condition; non-wildcard requires known_bot, category is a UA claim, not identity verification.

token.description: Shown once; never include in URL, logs or shared artifacts.

developmentLoopback.description: false for production PHP bootstrap; loopback development is an explicit operator change

installationProof.description: Canonical base64url of 32 random bytes generated client-side, kept private for bounded recovery.

routingVersion.description: CLI support for per-link fallback/audience. API PHP decisions run centrally.

credential.description: Returned only on enroll or proven bounded recovery, stored privately.

ip.description: Canonical IPv4/IPv6 determined by trusted proxy policy, not adapter socket IP.

Signals.description: Trusted PHP adapter forwards canonical visitor IP and UA, distinct from API socket IP. Country/device/OS/browser/ASN/risk/clientHints overrides are rejected. Full IP and raw UA remain transient; keyed request digest is persisted.

eventId.description: 32 random bytes, unpadded base64url; keep ID/timestamp/body unchanged on retry.

DecisionRequest.description: PHP/API agent only. Same agent/event ID and canonical request returns immutable original decision within 48-hour occurredAt window, even after publication. Changed payload is 409. Durable response and classified source=php event commit together before 200.

linkId.description: Selected link resolves domain plus effective global/domain/link rules.

proxyStatus.description: Synthetic simulator signal; never queries provider.

SimulationRequest.description: Published rules by default. ruleSetId requires expectedRevision and substitutes that saved draft only. knownBot is a synthetic signal; enabled bot rules cannot publish until B13.

osVersion.description: Optional detected value, null/absent if unavailable; never invent exact hardware models.

browserVersion.description: Optional detected value, null/absent if unavailable; never invent exact hardware models.

deviceBrand.description: Optional detected value, null/absent if unavailable; never invent exact hardware models.

deviceModel.description: Optional detected value, null/absent if unavailable; never invent exact hardware models.

bufferedEvents.description: Non-durable memory buffer and writer batch; optional for older agents.

queueWriteErrors.description: Queue write failures; optional for older agents.

protectionVersion.description: 1 means B13 parser/feed/rate/mode support; optional for old agents.

signedPayload.description: Base64url (unpadded) exact JSON bytes signed with Ed25519. Verify these bytes using the pinned bootstrap public key, then evaluate decoded fields; envelope fields are not independently authenticated.

downloadUrl.description: Signed relative path on configured control origin; arbitrary origins are rejected.

signedPayload.description: Base64url original JSON payload. Verify Ed25519 over decoded bytes; use only decoded signed payload.

downloadUrl.description: Allowlisted path relative to the configured control origin.

imageId.description: Observed Docker image ID; containerd-backed engines may report the OCI manifest ID.

imageReference.description: Optional registry/repository@sha256 manifest digest. Registry auth is provisioned separately.

imageConfigDigest.description: SHA256 of the image archive config. Loaded image IDs may use this on engines with a classic image store.

signedPayload.description: Exact JSON bytes base64url signed with Ed25519; only decoded signed fields are authoritative.

installerReady.description: False in B09; automatic installation is B10.

password.description: B03 owner passwords are 12–256 UTF-8 bytes; server validates byte length.

csrfToken.description: Session-bound token returned only to the authenticated admin; send in X-CSRF-Token for mutations.

destination.description: HTTP(S) only, no embedded credentials or redirect loop.

expectedRevision.description: Required by PATCH; omitted on initial create.

OperatingSystem.description: Normalized OS family. ios includes positively identified iOS/iPadOS; other is recognized unsupported OS, unknown is missing/ambiguous.

BrowserFamily.description: Browser product family, not rendering engine; independent of OS.

destinationSource.description: link resolves the selected shortlink published destination; custom requires destination and is edited independently.

mandatory.description: Only permitted for global block rules; matching enabled mandatory blocks precede routing regardless of scope priority.

os.description: AND condition; * permits any value including unknown.

browser.description: AND condition; * permits any value including unknown.

asn.description: Optional ASN condition; unavailable ASN never matches.

EventHealth.description: Pending/worker watermark for all events. Queue and active/stale counts cover CLI agents only, not idle PHP adapters. Watermark is last worker transaction, not completeness.

SignedRiskFeed.description: Authenticated signed payload contains schema=1, publication/expiry/source timestamps and Tor/reputation lists; verify exact bytes before decoding or activating.

signedPayload.description: Exact JSON bytes base64url signed with Ed25519; only decoded signed fields are authoritative.

ipQualityBlock.description: Flags whose true value routes to the link fallback. Empty array denies no IP flags. Omitted preserves legacy proxy/vpn/tor/botnet behavior.

dailyBudget.description: Required when provider is ProxyCheck; ignored for BEON (no daily cap).

key.description: One-use access key; never place in a URL.

OpeningQuery.description: Empty slug is root/public missing path; exact slug checks published existence for HEAD.

ManageSessionInput.description: Agent-bound session; update/logout require CSRF. Server derives domain from authenticated agent; no arbitrary domain/link mutation.
